user_questions.question: (Q1) How is this org connected to Slack? A) Salesforce-for-Slack app connection (org has sfdc_slack 'Slack Integration User', SlackElevateUser, SlackServiceUser permission sets) using the standard flow 'Send Message' Slack action - recommended; B) a Slack incoming webhook through a new named credential (no Slack credential exists today). (Q2) What should the message contain and when should it fire? A) storefront name and account name when Status__c becomes Suspended - recommended; B) also include owner, primary contact, and a record link.
user_questions.simulated_answer: Q1: No preference; use your recommended default. Q2: Message with storefront name and account on status -> Suspended.

skill_friction: Unclear whether 'which Slack connection mechanism' (native Slack app vs webhook named credential) is an intent question (external platform) or an implementation question; asked it but mapped 'no preference' to an assumption.
Skill has no guidance for verifying a Slack workspace connection; no allowed command can confirm it, so the flow had to be Conditional on an unverifiable prerequisite.

AskCoworker got documented flow behavior wrong in R ('updated to meet' never fires on create) and in I (channel name input, synchronous callout); Section 8 Resolved records the fixes, but the skill says not to spend follow-ups, so T was sent with the corrected facts only.
The Q2 message-content question borders on 'decide yourself' (requirement does not specify content); skill does not say whether message content/payload is intent or implementation.
